_comment: Gzip (level 9) budget per built file in KB, checked by `npm run size:check` in CI. The page loads index.js and the chunk-*.js files at once (together at most 50 KB, the Step 5 budget for initial JS); engine and structure load only when a session records replay. index.js was raised from 42.0 to 42.5 for the fixes of the PR #182 review (fetch init stand-in, consent ordering, outbox ownership). Raise a budget only in a PR that says why.
